description: Clean CCI setup, frozen CPU/CUDA inference, current-source CPU 8-step and CUDA 49-step accuracy runs, independent raw-GT/saved-coordinate audits, and verified task-instance shutdown passed. Earlier negative controls remain preserved; excluded paper/timing/physical scopes are not qualified.
qualification_runtime_scope: Qualification covers the recorded NGC PyTorch 25.06, Ubuntu 24.04, H100 runtime with frozen Python 3.10.12, Torch 2.6.0+cpu or 2.6.0+cu124, and cu124 cuDNN 9.19.0.56. Shared paper exporters retained TF32 override 1/high with matmul/cuDNN TF32 enabled; public CUDA inference used scoped strict FP32 and restored caller settings. This is not a guarantee for every GPU, container, or precision configuration.

source.source_isolation: Initial cold CPU reproduction used the unmodified base clone. Earlier API/checker/receipt controls used separate source and environment follow-ups. Final qualification used the explicitly frozen consolidated v4 patch in a fresh source checkout and its own virtual environment, official locked cuDNN 9.19 libraries, all thirteen source/test fingerprints, both inference profiles, and complete CUDA accuracy/audit checks. A separate fresh external CPU-only environment verified the final default CPU guide while preserving the GPU environment byte-for-byte. Verified assets and locked dependency/Python caches were reused; these follow-ups were not second cold setups.
source.saved_pose_correction_scope: Pose receipts describe the saved prediction coordinates. Training, saved predictions, paper reference values, and accuracy thresholds are unchanged.

base_provenance.scope: Original cold setup and earlier API/checker/saved-pose controls used the original base lockfile. The final source and installed backend are identified separately below.

cold_setup.network_and_authentication: Restricted-host HTTPS connectivity and authenticated repository/Hub access were configured before the successful clone and private downloads. No credentials are included in this artifact.
cold_setup.native_library_setup: Inherited system-PyTorch Python 3.12 library paths were removed from LD_LIBRARY_PATH; NVIDIA driver paths were retained for the locked Python 3.10 runtime.

assets.mano_requirement: Separately licensed MANO_LEFT.pkl and MANO_RIGHT.pkl; not fetched from the release Hub repositories.

observed_mano_fingerprints.scope: Live fingerprints observed during the qualification work from the separately licensed files at the MANO_PATH used by CCI, cross-checked against the same files locally. Not initial-run hashes, a version assertion, or redistributed MANO payloads.

followup_setup.note: Corrected API and CUDA reproduction validations are source/environment-isolated followups, not a second cold network or asset-download qualification.

api_patch_source.note: The same 70 tests were executed separately on both profiles, not 140 distinct tests.

saved_pose_source_local_cpu.scope: Local locked CPU virtual environment; not a new CCI cold setup or CCI CPU-v3 reproduction run.

final_frozen_release_source.note: The same 81 tests passed separately on both final frozen profiles, not 162 distinct tests.

final_default_cpu_environment.scope: The same final 81-test suite ran once more in the separate CPU-only environment, not 81 additional unique tests.

precision_environment.scope: Fresh subprocess observations before importing Torch, limited to the four named Torch/NVIDIA precision-related variables, plus actual backend flags and precision. Both original and corrected cu124 virtual environments were observed; these values alone do not establish a cause or guarantee behavior outside this NGC 25.06 H100 runtime.

normal_inference.precision: Public API CUDA calls disable TF32 and autocast only during calibration/prediction and restore caller settings; CPU is unchanged. Shared paper exporters and baselines retain their original precision behavior.

cu124.source_scope: Final frozen v4 source and own-venv dependencies.

cuda_eval_all_methods.row_pass_scope: All twelve official verifier-reported accuracy rows passed in a complete 49-step run and independent raw-GT/saved-coordinate audit. The final default CPU guide was independently qualified separately.

reproduction.aggregation_and_protocol: Each table/method verifies all seeds and complete recording/variant units; masked pose metrics are unit-averaged, Table 2 baseline pinch is event-weighted, YOCO pinch is unit-averaged. Calibration is K=4 from [0,200), evaluation is all [200,T). No truncation or uniform-cohort substitution.
reproduction.table2_cohort_note: YOCO/Ridge/last-layer/full fine-tuning use three right-hand AVP recordings; no-calibration/LoRA use the historical four-recording mapped cohort. Original paper cohorts remain unchanged.

saved_ridge_payload_preservation.scope: Ridge only: original failed v2 full run versus the corrected v3 three-seed AVP probe. No bitwise claim for other methods.

initial_locked_cudnn91_v3.followup_note: The failed runner stopped at 46/49. Its AVP LoRA and no-calibration verifiers were subsequently executed as explicit diagnostics, yielding 12 total verifier receipts and 11 passing rows; neither the runner nor independent final audit was changed to passing.
initial_locked_cudnn91_v3.row_pass_scope: Individual verifier-reported aggregate accuracy. The independent complete-suite auditor rejected the incomplete failed runner; these row results are not a substitute for a complete green audit.

final_default_cpu_legacy_yoco.scope: Final frozen v4 source with the documented default CPU profile, separate from the preserved original-base cold CPU proof.
final_default_cpu_legacy_yoco.command_scope: The documented default CPU runner was executed against the final frozen v4 source using a fresh external CPU-only UV environment to retain the qualified GPU environment byte-for-byte. Locked wheel/Python caches and verified assets were reused, not a second cold setup.

preserved_failures.resolution: Configured restricted-host network routing and repository authentication before the successful clean clone; no original receipt was rewritten.
Removed inherited Python 3.12 system-PyTorch native-library paths while preserving driver paths; frozen lockfile and package targets were unchanged.

A matched all-TF32-off control passed the original inference tolerances; public API precision is now scoped and restored. cuDNN-TF32-only disabling did not resolve all drift. No checkpoint, shared exporter, or tolerance changes were made.

metric_receipt_consistency.scope: Only saved per-unit metric receipts versus independent recomputation; both original export pose means and replay use NumPy on CPU. This allowance does not establish a GPU reduction cause or change aggregate accuracy tolerance.

preserved_failures.resolution: The observed saved/replayed discrepancy was at float32 scale; its InterHand cause was not independently isolated. The first checker correction added a finite eight-float32-epsilon relative comparison allowance with the existing 1e-5 absolute floor. It did not resolve every discrepancy: the later unchanged-source AVP Ridge diagnostic specifically isolated the separate held-out versus saved full-session GPU prediction tuples. Original negative receipts remain negative; aggregate accuracy references and bounds were not changed.

The CUDA legacy export did not match the CPU legacy release references and remains a failed comparison. Final CUDA qualification explicitly uses eval conditioning and the pre-existing eval reference, not new targets or relaxed aggregate accuracy tolerances.

Unchanged-source diagnosis showed the separate held-out versus persisted full-session prediction forward dominated the discrepancy; GPU-versus-NumPy target-transform metric effects were at most 1.862645149230957e-6 mm. The receipt correction computes pose metrics from actual saved prediction coordinates and canonical NumPy ground truth without changing training procedures, prediction-saving logic, precision flags, references, or accuracy bounds. Ridge saved payload preservation was proven separately. The subsequent official frozen v4 complete run and independent audit passed; this original negative remains negative.

issues: ValueError: Corrected clone contains undeclared untracked files
preserved_failures.resolution: The subsequent frozen source specification explicitly declares and fingerprints eleven tracked release files and two additional regression tests. The final complete v4b independent source/accuracy audit passed; this original negative receipt remains negative.

preserved_failures.failure_scope: Real aggregate paper-accuracy mismatch, not a saved-coordinate receipt consistency failure. Passing partial rows do not qualify a complete run.
preserved_failures.resolution: The matched backend-only diagnostic passed this AVP full-FT comparison with cuDNN 9.19 instead of 9.1, retaining the locked Python/NumPy/Torch and override 1 settings. That establishes sufficiency for unchanged score tolerances in the probe, not exact historical flags. A fresh official pinned own-venv cuDNN 9.19.0.56 installation subsequently passed the complete 49-step run and independent audit; the v3 negative receipts remain negative.

issues: ValueError: Final runner is incomplete or failed; never aggregate partial progress
preserved_failures.resolution: The independent auditor rejected the failed 46-step runner and did not aggregate partial CUDA progress. A subsequent complete 49-step frozen v4 runner and independent v4b audit passed; this negative receipt remains negative.

preserved_failures.details: See diagnostics: original negative runner and verifier/log hashes are preserved; neither diagnostic qualifies the complete release suite.
See diagnostics: original negative runner and verifier/log hashes are preserved; neither diagnostic qualifies the complete release suite.

preserved_failures.issue_summary: Source checkout manifest unavailable at control execution time.
preserved_failures.resolution: A premature independent control could not access the new validation checkout/source manifest and did not evaluate accuracy. The subsequent complete v4b audit passed; the original premature-control receipt remains negative.

The audit control incorrectly required an explicit --save-predictions argument, although the baseline parser uses BooleanOptionalAction with default=True. Saved exports existed. Correcting only the control interpretation yielded the passing v4b independent audit; no model source, export, reference, or threshold was rerun or changed for this audit correction.

preserved_failures.scope: Controller import under the container system Python 3.12 failed before a validation virtual environment or run ledger was created. This is not a model/export/regression-test failure.
preserved_failures.resolution: The corrected control ran with the qualified v4 virtual-environment Python 3.10 interpreter and a sanitized native-library wrapper. The final own-environment CPU 81-test suite, default 8-step reproduction, and independent replay passed; the original preflight log remains unchanged.

independent_final_audit.scope: Original cold CPU guide, prior FP32 API validation, fresh locked CPU/CUDA v4 setup/API and complete CUDA paper reproduction with independent raw-GT/saved-coordinate replay.

independent_cuda_replay.scope: Independent raw dataset ground truth and persisted full-sequence prediction coordinates; not model-forward bitwise equality or hardware timing.

evidence_note: Raw receipts, logs, and saved predictions live under ignored eval/results on the validation workspace. This portable artifact publishes measured summaries and receipt hashes, not credentials, licensed MANO payloads, or remote mount paths.

diagnostics.scope: Matched controls and historical-interpreter observations are diagnostics, not a complete release-uv qualification. No probe changes the paper reference or accuracy thresholds.

override_zero_full_ft_probe.command: TORCH_ALLOW_TF32_CUBLAS_OVERRIDE=0 uv run --frozen --extra cu124 python scripts/reproduce_paper.py --table 2 --methods full_ft --device cuda --conditioning-mode eval --output-dir <fresh-probe-results>
override_zero_full_ft_probe.precision_scope: Only the cuBLAS TF32 override was changed. The corresponding fresh backend observation reported matmul TF32 false/highest, but cuDNN TF32 remained true; this is not an all-TF32-off control.
override_zero_full_ft_probe.interpretation: Changing the override moved measured full-FT results but did not resolve the release accuracy gate: pinch difference remained -0.06131528858926316 mm versus the unchanged 0.05 mm bound. It does not establish a complete causal explanation.

historical_interpreter_probe.scope: Historical interpreter only, not a historical full environment reconstruction or a locked-uv qualification.
historical_interpreter_probe.failure: ImportError: libGL.so.1: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
historical_interpreter_probe.failure_stage: Training began, but no complete seed export or verifier finished.
historical_interpreter_probe.interpretation: The historical interpreter reported different Python/NumPy/h5py/cuDNN versions, but this probe produced no qualified aggregate comparison. No single-library or precision-cause claim is established.

cudnn919_backend_only_probe.scope: Backend-only diagnostic using existing cuDNN libraries, not a frozen release-uv installation or a complete-suite qualification.
cudnn919_backend_only_probe.interpretation: Under the same locked Python 3.10.12, NumPy 1.23.5, Torch 2.6.0+cu124, and TF32 override 1 configuration, loading cuDNN 9.19 instead of 9.1 was sufficient for this three-seed AVP full-FT comparison to pass unchanged score tolerances. This is not an exact historical precision/environment reconstruction. A subsequent official pinned own-venv installation passed the complete 49-step CUDA run and independent audit.

instance_lifecycle.scope: Shutdown verified by both sanitized live CCI app and instance API responses; only the task-owned app was stopped. Configured replicas=1 is its retained resume configuration, not an active allocation.

final_source.scope: All eleven frozen tracked release files plus the two declared regression test files in the fresh v4 checkout. Source identity is distinct from original-base provenance and prior failed attempts.

cu124_platform_prerequisite.scope: The pinned official cuDNN 9.19 wheel requires this Linux glibc minimum; the CCI qualification is not a universal platform compatibility guarantee.

final_uv_install.library_scope: The cu124 runtime asserted its cuDNN 9.19.0.56 distribution and mapped libraries are inside the new virtual environment, not historical LD_LIBRARY_PATH cuDNN libraries.
final_uv_install.test_count_note: The same 81 tests passed separately in cpu and cu124 profiles, not 162 distinct tests.
